# How much of my bonus do I actually keep?

> Free UK bonus tax calculator for 2026/27: how much of a bonus you keep after income tax, National Insurance, student loan, the 60% personal allowance trap and the Child Benefit charge, and what paying part into your pension would change. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
